name: Camlan

attributes.attribute: site of the final battle of King Arthur
destination of Arthur after the battle

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Camlan is a Welsh mythological site. Writers also use the forms Camluau and Camlan. The exact spot stays unknown. Early writers call it the place where King Arthur fought his last battle. Arthur lost that fight to his son and nephew, Mordred. From Camlan the Lady of the Lake carried Arthur into the Otherworld.

okr.objective: Camluau is the Welsh battlefield where King Arthur fell to Mordred.
key_results: Camluau is a Welsh mythological site.
Writers also use the form Camluann.
Early writers call it the site of the final battle of King Arthur.
Arthur met defeat there at the hands of Mordred.
The Lady of the Lake carried Arthur away into the Otherworld.
